Rosa (Finance): Sparkline reached out — they say a $4,500 credit posted twice on their May invoice INV-2026-3007. Can billing ops check?
Maya (Acct): I see two credit lines both labeled GW-APR-2026 $4,500. Customer says they only received one goodwill refund from a support case.
Eli (Billing Ops): Quick check: looks like a manual goodwill credit was issued 2026-05-02 for SUP-11234, then our nightly refund-recon job also detected an unresolved support refund and issued an automated credit the next morning. Both used same amount but different txn ids.
Eli (Billing Ops): Relevant audit lines:
2026-05-02T18:12:10Z manual_credit acct=spl-900 invoice=INV-2026-3007 amt=4500 code=GW-SUP ref=SUP-11234 txn=CR-2026-8B1D
2026-05-03T02:05:33Z refund-recon job=refund-recon acct=spl-900 detect=missing_refund action=auto_credit amt=4500 code=AR-AUTO ref=SUP-11234 txn=CR-2026-8F3C
Maya (Acct): So customer got made whole twice. Theyre worried about reversals appearing as charges.
Rosa (Finance): Policy: if duplicate credit was caused by automation that replayed a valid manual refund, we should reverse the automated one and notify the customer. If reversal would create payment issues, offer to keep both and issue a billing hold instead.
Eli (Billing Ops): I'll reverse the auto credit (txn CR-2026-8F3C) with code REV-AUTO and note "auto-replay duplicate of manual GW-SUP". Running: vb adjust-reversal --acct spl-900 --amount 4500 --currency USD --invoice INV-2026-3007 --txn CR-2026-8F3C --code REV-AUTO --note "auto-replay duplicate of manual GW-SUP"
recon-bot: Action queued: reversal_pending | id=BILL-12021 | acct=spl-900 | amt=4500 USD
recon-bot: Action completed: reversal | id=BILL-12021 | status=completed | txn=RV-2026-C9D2
Maya (Acct): Notified Sparkline: "Hi 		Sparkline 			we found an automated credit replayed a manual goodwill refund. We've reversed the automated credit (txn RV-2026-C9D2). This will appear as a reversal line on your next statement; it does not trigger an immediate charging action. If that causes any reconciliation problems, reply and we'll keep the reversal on hold or issue a make-whole."
Sparkline replied: "Thanks for fixing and the clear note, no issues on our side." :thumbsup:
Rosa (Finance): Please tag rc=refund-recon-replay and add a mitigation: refund-recon should check for recent manual_credit ref tags before auto-applying. Closing after ledger reconciliation.
